content.value: A ground based air-surveillance radar operates at a frequency of 1300Míz (L-band). its maximum range is 200 pmi for the detection of a target with a radar cross section of one square meter $( \sigma ^ { = } \mathrm { l n } ^ { 2 } )$ . Its antenna is 12m wide by 4m high and the antenna aperture efficiency is $\rho _ { \tt a } = 0 . 6 5$ . The receiver minimum detectable signal is $\mathrm { S } _ { \mathfrak { w i n } } { \overset { . } { = } } 1 \mathfrak { d } ^ { - 1 3 } \mathbb { W }$ . Determine the followings:
